product_description: Software that plans and schedules domiciliary (home) care visits. It builds carers' daily runs, optimises routes to cut mileage, fuel and travel time, reduces missed and late visits, and gives care providers per-run cost analytics. Uses optimisation and AI/ML for scheduling. Aimed at home-care providers and at Health and Social Care Trusts (HSC) in Northern Ireland, with GB and Republic of Ireland providers as the growth market. Supports hospital discharge-to-home capacity.
customers: NHS trusts and integrated care boards

company.stage: early-stage start-up, pre-revenue or early revenue, product in development (around TRL 5-6)

fit_points: private care providers' mileage and fuel costs
funding_angles: Net Zero, transport decarbonisation and fleet efficiency funds (mileage and fuel savings)
digital health and social care innovation calls
hospital discharge and care-at-home capacity programmes
health tech accelerators open to NI companies
